title: a bloodborne castlevania platformer demo
author: DueResponse2717
selftext:
I made a bloodborne-inspired demo scene in a castlevania platformer genre during this weekend and found I am kind of love the vibe it finally comes out with.

Most of the assets and actual coding works are done with AI-saves my ass cuz I am not a good pixel painter.

How do you guys like it? I am considering to expand it in the next a few months with real gameplay and story narrative. Leave any comments/suggestions!

comments.author: teamharder
comments.body: Looks decent. Maybe you already know, but the MC art style is different than your enemies. This is a bit odd. Also, the MC walk animation needs work. Blade flashes one frame and then disappears. Decent art otherwise. Nice work.

replies.author: DueResponse2717
replies.body: definitely, I do find most of my time was consumed in pixel sprite/animation generation. it is still somewhat hard for AI to follow instruction and keep all the nuances aligned in different frames. thank you for the suggestions!

comments.author: Illustrious-Lime-863
comments.body: Very good work for a weekend project. You can play the sport

comments.author: FeeAshamed5377
comments.body: very good work bro, did you use godot for implement? and how abou your assets creation?

replies.author: DueResponse2717
replies.body: yes it's on godot and the sprites is mainly generated by AI with minor post modifications manually.

replies.author: FeeAshamed5377
replies.body: thank you, can you share me which AI using for the assets, i saw the game graphic is look great also

replies.author: DueResponse2717
replies.body: I use pixellab for this demo but I suppose there are many other alternatives

replies.author: Agreeable-Safety-360
replies.body: As 98% of the projects in this sub do

comments.author: Agreeable-Safety-360
comments.body: Explain how you didn't the attack animations and weapon transforming. I doubt that was image to video

comments.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
comments.body: Looks interesting but if you need to be told that your main character has a regular proportional body while that enemy is in chibi anime art style, then I am not interested in anything you'll be making. If something like that doesn't jump out to you when you're generating your sprites with whatever AI sprite tool you're using, then there are going to be holes throughout this entire project

replies.author: DueResponse2717
replies.body: indeed, I noticed that issue and thanks for pointing it out!

comments.author: AnonymousAggregator
comments.body:
I like the scale of the main character.

Reminds me of the old bat man games.

Feels cozy, keep going,
